description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets available for different languages from 2012 to 2021. The horizontal axis represents the year, labeled linearly from 2012 to 2021, while the vertical axis represents the number of datasets, labeled linearly on a logarithmic scale from 10⁰ to 10².  The chart displays grouped bars for each year, with each group representing a different language: English (blue), All other (orange), Arabic (green), Bengali (red), Spanish (purple), and Russian (brown). In 2012, the English language has a bar of approximately 1.5 datasets, while all other languages have a bar of approximately 0.2 datasets. By 2019, the English language bar reaches approximately 95 datasets, and the “All other” language bar reaches approximately 20 datasets. In 2021, the English language has a bar of approximately 100 datasets, while the Russian language has a bar of approximately 12 datasets. The bars are sorted chronologically by year, and no bars are visually emphasized.
